an4.4:1.1: catūsu bhikkhave, micchā paṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuṃ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:1.3: mātari bhikkhave, micchā paṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:1.4: pitari bhikkhave, micchā paṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgate bhikkhave, micchā paṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave, micchā paṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuṃ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:1.5: imesu kho bhikkhave, catūsu micchā paṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuṃ ca apuññaṃ pasavatīti.
an4.4:2.1: catūsu bhikkhave, sammā paṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuṃ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.3: mātari bhikkhave, sammā paṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuṃ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.4: pitari bhikkhave, sammā paṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgate bhikkhave, sammā paṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave, sammā paṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.5: imesu kho bhikkhave, catūsu sammā paṭipajjamāno paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti.
